proof.protocol: At each NEW discordance d<=128, use the frozen probability depending only on(d,min(k,d-k)), draw one independent uniform integer U in[0,10^12), and report the strict current majority iff U<threshold. On a report stop; on a nonreport atH128 permanently abstain from further reports.
proof.path_weight: For a particular sign prefix z of length d with k plus signs, its first-report weight equals q^k(1-q)^(d-k) times the product of earlier continue probabilities and the final report probability. These policy-coin factors are fixed and do not depend on q.
proof.uniform_positive_error: A plus-report prefix has k>d/2. On0<q<=1/2, the derivative of log[q^k(1-q)^(d-k)] is(k-dq)/(q(1-q))>0. Therefore every such prefix likelihood is<=2^(-d), with the q=0 boundary by continuity. Multiplying by its same policy-coin weight and summing disjoint first-report prefixes gives P_q(report plus)<=P_.5(report plus).
proof.negative_error: Reflect every sign word and use the same folded-state probability. This bijection shows equal plus/minus fair risks and gives P_q(report minus)<=P_.5(report minus) for fixed q>=1/2.
proof.null_union: At q=.5 both report directions are errors and their disjoint union has the independently recomputed exact risk alpha<=.01. At fixed strict alternatives the wrong direction is bounded by alpha/2<=.005.
proof.physical_cap: For fixed iid physical PSR pairs, conditional discordant signs have one fixed q. Couple the runtime to the full latent sign stream and the same independent policy coins. A physical cap only prevents some latent reports from arriving. Concordant pairs must NOT redraw a policy coin. AfterH128 no reports are permitted; charging remaining pairs to the physical cap changes cost, not risk.
proof.randomness_semantics: The strict integer comparison accepts exactly threshold of the denominator possible integer values, so the report probability is exactly the stored rational. This assumes genuinely independent uniform integer input; the audit does not claim that an arbitrary caller/RNG supplies this contract.
proof.scope_limit: The prefix proof uses a single fixed iid q and does not establish control for arbitrary history-dependent changing q, policy retuning from outcomes, repeated coins at the same state, or continuing after a terminal report/horizon.

runtime_contract_review.hash_and_exact_risk_before_use: load_policy registers an immutable policy only after structural validation and exact risk checking. Unverified policy objects are rejected.
runtime_contract_review.majority_and_tie: Every tie threshold is zero. The runtime strict comparison thus cannot report a tie; reflected counts report the reflected sign.
runtime_contract_review.horizon: Inputs outside1<=d<=128 are rejected. At128 a nonreport returnsabstain.
runtime_contract_review.caller_statefulness: decide is intentionally a stateless decision kernel. The caller must enforce exactly one call/coin per new discordance and absorbing stop/abstention. These protocol obligations are necessary for the theorem; the physical evaluation plan and direct DP enforce them.
runtime_contract_review.input_types: Counts and uniform_integer must be Python ints, excluding bool; an external numpy integer draw needs explicit int conversion.
runtime_contract_review.no_truth_input: Only verified table, paid counts and a fresh independent coin enter decide. No true or estimated q is accepted.

not_claimed: No exact global optimality of the floating occupancy LP.
No power guarantee away from explicitly checked design points.
No certified physical-cost gain or SOTA novelty from this risk review.
